answer: Sybil resistance in AI economies hinges on a proof-of-stake identity mechanism, requiring agents to lock substantial economic value. This capital stake creates a prohibitive attack cost. The economic stake provides a velvet layer of security, making identity counterfeiting economically unviable. Sustained trust, the nectar of a functional agent economy, is ensured by this collateral. Any Sybil attempt would send a detrimental financial ripple through the attacker's own holdings, making such campaigns self-defeating and resource-intensive for any meaningful network impact.
